title: F03: LLM client + extractor: prompts, JSON schema, repair, recorded-response tests
milestone: M3 Extraction pipeline
labels: backend, ai
---
## Goal
Call the local vision model via Ollama and turn its output into a validated extraction result.

**Depends on:** F02
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Recorded responses cover: valid, malformed (repaired), malformed (repair fails), missing fields, `is_receipt=false`
- [ ] Timeout and connection errors are mapped to typed errors
- [ ] No test calls a live model
